Test Case Title: Open the page and check the dynamic button shows "START".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Test Steps: 1. Scroll to the dynamic button. 2. Read its label, name and class.
Expected Result: The label is "START", the name is "start" and the class contains "start".

Test Case Title: Click the dynamic button twice and check it changes to "STOP" and back to "START".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Test Steps: 1. Click the button. 2. Read label, name and class. 3. Click the button again. 4. Read label and class.
Expected Result: After the first click it is "STOP" (name "stop"). After the second click it is "START" again.
